messages:
Javier (People Ops): Quick FYI — Lina was on a 12-week client secondment in Toronto from 2025-09-01 to 2025-11-23. She remained on Redwood US payroll, but vendor withheld Canadian CPP and EI on her Oct payrun. She lives in CA and had no Canadian employment docs. Lina noticed reduced net pay. Can payroll advise?
Ashley (Payroll): Oof. Do we have the payslip and vendor remittance detail? CPP/EI withholdings usually only apply if employer established payroll in Canada or employee on a Canadian contract.
Lina (Eng): I uploaded the payslip to the HR portal and DM'd the boarding passes. I was still on my US employment agreement. No Canadian offer letter or work permit changes.
MaplePayroll (Vendor): Seeing the payroll run now — our geo-match service flagged active Toronto IPs during the payroll window and created a Canada payroll batch for Lina by mistake. The system applied standard CPP/EI rates and vendor transaction ID MP-CA-202510. We remitted to CRA on 2025-10-30.
Sam (Legal): If remitted to CRA, we need to start a reclaim; CRA has a process for employer/employee CPP/EI overpayments if not actually employed in Canada. Also check whether CPP employer contributions were recorded in benefits — those may need reversal.
Nina (Benefits): We saw an employer CPP contribution on the ledger for Oct 2025. That will affect our benefits cost center. If it's reversed we need confirmation to adjust the GL.
Ashley (Payroll): OK: two parallel tracks — 1) vendor reclaim with CRA (likely 6-12 weeks), 2) internal short-term reimbursement option for Lina if she wants immediate net pay correction. Need confirmation from Legal and Finance.
Javier (People Ops): Lina prefers quick fix if doable. Can payroll do a one-off gross reimbursement and then recoup from vendor if reclaim succeeds?
Sam (Legal): Yes, we can do an interim reimbursement but we should document it as "advance reimbursement pending vendor/CRA reclaim" and have Lina sign an acknowledgement. Also check cross-border tax treaty exceptions for pension/CPP recapture.
MaplePayroll (Vendor): We'll open ticket MP-CA-202510-REC and start reclaim paperwork. For CRA refund we need: employee travel records, copy of US employment contract, original remittance receipt, and signed declaration that employment remained with Redwood US. We'll also provide CRA reference numbers once submitted.
PayrollBot: Ticket created: MP-CA-202510-REC — Type: Canada CPP/EI Reclaim — Owner: MaplePayroll — ETA initial acknowledgement 3 business days. <https://vendor.example.com/tickets/MP-CA-202510-REC>
Ashley (Payroll): Lina, can you confirm you'll sign the acknowledgement? Also please upload the boarding passes, hotel folios, and a scanned copy of your US employment agreement.
Lina (Eng): Yes I will sign. Uploaded docs to the vendor portal and sent the signed statement to People Ops.
Nina (Benefits): Please note: if reclaim is successful and employer CPP is refunded, we'll reverse the employer contribution in benefits and notify Finance for GL correction. If reclaim fails, we need to decide whether Redwood absorbs employer CPP or passes through (not preferred).
MaplePayroll (Vendor): Update: CRA reject is possible if the employer EIN was used previously in Canada; we'll push the reclaim but can only proceed with CRA guidance. If CRA accepts, refund time ~8 weeks. We'll share remittance snapshots and reclaim forms.
Ashley (Payroll): I'll prepare the interim reimbursement workflow for Finance approval: amount netted from Lina's Oct payslip (CPP+EI employee share). I'll copy Legal on the acknowledgement doc.
Sam (Legal): I'll draft the acknowledgement and include language: "advance reimbursement subject to repayment if CRA denies reclaim" and specify documentation required.
Javier (People Ops): Thanks. Please post updates here. Lina — sorry for the hassle. :heart:
PayrollBot: Vendor update MP-CA-202510-REC: Reclaim package submitted to CRA on 2025-12-02. Reference: CRA-REF-9942. Next update expected in 6-8 weeks.
Ashley (Payroll): Finance approved one-off net reimbursement. Processed a $312 USD grossed advance to Lina today (transaction TX-20251203-PR). We'll reconcile with vendor refund when/if received.
Lina (Eng): Thank you, team. Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will keep receipts and any CRA correspondence.
MaplePayroll (Vendor): Noted. We'll attach remittance proof and CRA responses to ticket when available.
Javier (People Ops): Closing loop — People Ops will archive travel docs and the acknowledgement in Lina's file. We'll update year-end reporting notes for T4/W-2 to avoid duplicate reporting flags.
PayrollBot: MP-CA-202510-REC ticket last updated: 2025-12-03 17:12 UTC.
